summary: During a long campaign a candidate privately reconsiders why they want the job.
realLife: After three months exploring a presidential run, Representative Pat Schroeder told supporters she saw too little time to catch up. She also described how the demands of seeking the nomination kept her apart from the people she wanted to reach.
inGame: needs: reflection tied to campaign duration rather than an officeholder’s office-doubt scene.

turns.what: The candidate decides to end the run after reflecting on the demands of the job.
turns.pulledBy: The office would require a commitment the candidate no longer wants to make.
turns.writesBack: The private decision precedes the campaign's public announcement.

turns.what: The candidate decides to keep running and gives up an overnight stop to make a family appointment.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate has an invitation for that night and a prior commitment at home.
turns.writesBack: The host gets a cancellation while the candidacy remains active.
